description: Source code for EffectsXmlConfigLoader, responsible for loading and parsing XML configuration files for effects, dynamically loading effect libraries, and managing effect descriptors within the Android media effects framework.

classes.name: LoadEffectResult
classes.description: Structure representing the result of loading an effect, including success status, associated library, and effect descriptor.

classes.name: UuidStr
classes.description: Structure holding a string buffer for UUID string representation.

methods.name: resolveLibrary
methods.description: Searches for a library in LD_EFFECT_LIBRARY_PATH and returns its absolute path.

methods.name: loadLibrary
methods.description: Loads a shared library given its relative path, verifies its effect library info, and fills lib_entry_t structure.

methods.name: makeUniqueC
methods.description: Creates a unique_ptr managing a malloc-allocated object.

methods.name: listPush
methods.description: Pushes an object into a linked list with optional mutex locking.

methods.name: loadLibraries
methods.description: Loads multiple libraries from a list, updating linked lists of loaded and failed libraries.

methods.name: findLibrary
methods.description: Finds a library by name in a linked list.

methods.name: uuidToString
methods.description: Converts a UUID to its string representation.

methods.name: loadEffect
methods.description: Loads an effect descriptor from a library, verifying API version and UUID uniqueness.

methods.name: loadEffects
methods.description: Loads multiple effects, handling proxies and sub-effects, updating linked lists.
